title: The circular fence poset block-statistic conjecture
statement:
Let $P$ be a circular fence poset of size $n$, let $S_n(P)$ denote the relevant set of permutations, and let $\widehat{bl}_P(\sigma)$ be the block statistic introduced for circular fence posets. Here $\Omega(P;t)$ is the order polynomial of $P$. **Circular fence block-statistic conjecture.** For every circular fence poset $P$ of size $n$,

$$
n! \, \Omega(P;t)=\sum_{\sigma\in S_n(P)}t^{\widehat{bl}_P(\sigma)}.
$$

This conjecture seeks a combinatorial interpretation of the coefficients of the order polynomial for circular fence posets, parallel to the established formula for ordinary fence posets. Its status is not specified in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11225

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2026).
source_name: Yakob Kahane, “Combinatorial interpretation of the coefficients of the order polynomial of fence posets”, arXiv:2607.11225 (2026).
